name: Iimpawu eziyingozi zokukhulelwa
tagline: Ukopha, intlungu enkulu, akukho ntshukumo — nini ukuya esibhedlele.
sources: Umbutho waseMzantsi Afrika wooGqirha bokuBeleka kunye neeGqirha zabafazi

urgent.heading: Yiya esibhedlele ngoku ukuba
urgent.primary_message: Iimpawu zengozi ekukhulelweni zinokwenza umahluko phakathi kobomi nokufa — kumama okanye kusana. Musa ukulinda. Musa ukuzithandabuza. Yiya.
red_flags: Ukopha kakhulu kwilungu langasese — ngaphezu kwexesha eliqhelekileyo lenyanga
Intlungu enkulu esiswini okanye emqolo engathambiyo
Intloko ebuhlungu kakhulu ehamba nokubona mfiliba okanye ukubona amachokoza
Ukudumba okukhulu ngesiquphe kobuso, izandla okanye iinyawo

what_is_it.heading: Kutheni oku kubalulekile
what_is_it.lede: Ukukhulelwa kudla ngokukhuseleka eMzantsi Afrika, kodwa ukusweleka koomama kusaxhaphake kakhulu — kwaye uninzi lunokuthintelwa. Ukwazi iimpawu zengozi nokwenza ngokukhawuleza kusindisa ubomi.
paragraphs: UMzantsi Afrika urekhoda ngaphezu kwe-1 000 yokusweleka koomama minyaka le. Ingxelo ye-Saving Mothers ibonisa ukuba uninzi lwenzeka ngenxa yezizathu ezinokuthintelwa — ukopha, uxinzelelo lwegazi oluphezulu, usulelo, iingxaki zeemeko ezazikhona ngaphambili. Ukufa okuninzi kwenzeka kuba iimpawu zesilumkiso ziye zajongelwa phantsi okanye unyango lwalibaziseka.

Awudingi ukwazi ukuba yintoni engalunganga. Kufuneka nje uqaphele ukuba kukho into engalunganga, uye esibhedlele. Unyango lokubelekisa lwasimahla luyafumaneka kuzo zonke izibhedlele zikarhulumente. Thembela kwimvakalelo yakho — ukuba kukho into evakala ingalunganga, kusenokwenzeka ukuba kunjalo.

items.body: Abasetyhini baseMzantsi Afrika basweleka ngexesha lokukhulelwa okanye lokubeleka minyaka le. Uninzi kakhulu lwezi kufa lunokuthintelwa.

items.headline: MomConnect
items.body: Inkxaso yasimahla yokukhulelwa ngeWhatsApp evela kwi-NDoH ngazo zonke iilwimi zaseMzantsi Afrika. Thumela 'Hi' ku-079 631 2456 ukuze ubhalise.

items.headline: Unyango lwasimahla
items.body: Lonke utyelelo lwangaphambi kokubeleka, ukuzalwa, kunye nonyango olungxamisekileyo lokubelekisa lusimahla kuzo zonke izibhedlele neekliniki zikarhulumente.

items.headline: Zithembe
items.body: Ukuba kukho into evakala ingalunganga, yiya uhlolwe. Abasebenzi bezempilo bangathanda bakubone nangona kungento, kunokuba baphoswe yinto enzulu.

pull_quote.text: Konke ukusweleka koomama kunebali leempawu zesilumkiso ezaphoswayo okanye zajongelwa phantsi. Ukuba ukhulelwe kwaye ukhathazekile, impendulo efanelekileyo isoloko ikukuba uhlolwe. Ngalo lonke ixesha.

signs.heading: Iimpawu zesilumkiso ngokwamanqanaba okukhulelwa
signs.lede: Ezinye iimpawu zibalulekile nangaliphi na ixesha. Ezinye zibaluleke ngakumbi ngamaxesha athile. Ukuba awuqinisekanga — hlolwa.

items.title: Iiveki zokuqala ezili-12
items.description: Ukopha kakhulu, intlungu enkulu kwicala elinye (isenokuba kukukhulelwa ngaphandle kwesibeleko — kuyingozi ebomini), ukugabha kakhulu okuthintela ukugcina ulwelo, ifiva engaphezu kwe-38Â°C.

items.title: Emva kweeveki ezili-12
items.description: Ukopha kakhulu, intloko ebuhlungu kakhulu ehamba notshintsho ekuboneni (kunokwenzeka pre-eclampsia), ukudumba okukhulu, ukuncipha okanye ukuyeka kweentshukumo zosana (emva kweeveki ezingama-28).

items.title: Kufuphi nexesha okanye emva kweeveki ezingama-37
items.description: Iintlungu zokuqina rhoqo, ukuphuka kwamanzi, ukopha, ukuncipha kwentshukumo yosana, intloko ebuhlungu kakhulu okanye intlungu yesisu. Musa ukuzama ukubala ixesha ekhaya — yiya.

items.title: Ukuba uphawu lwengozi luyavela — yiya esibhedlele
items.description: Musa ukuziqhubela ukuba ungakuphepha. Biza i-ambulensi okanye ucele umntu akuqhube. Thatha ikhadi lakho lokukhulelwa okanye incwadi yekliniki.

items.title: Musa ukuzama ukubala ixesha leempawu ekhaya
items.description: Intlungu enkulu, ukopha okanye utshintsho ekuboneni azidingi kulinganiswa ixesha. Yiya. I-pre-eclampsia nokukhulelwa ngaphandle kwesibeleko zingabulala ngaphakathi kweeyure.

items.title: Yiya kwisibhedlele obhukhe kuso okanye esikufutshane
items.description: Izibhedlele zikarhulumente kufuneka zamkele iimeko ezingxamisekileyo zokukhulelwa nokuba ubhukhe phi. Thatha amaxwebhu akho ukuba unawo.

items.title: Ukuba awuqinisekanga — thumela umyalezo kuMomConnect
items.description: Inkxaso yasimahla ngeWhatsApp — Thumela 'Hi' ku-079 631 2456. Ikliniki yakho inokukuxelela ukuba uze na. Xa ungqina, khetha isibhedlele.

items.title: Yiya kulo lonke utyelelo lwangaphambi kokubeleka
items.description: Uninzi lweempawu zengozi lubanjwa kwangoko kutyelelo oluqhelekileyo lwangaphambi kokubeleka. Lwasimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki. Ishedyuli inceda ukuthintela iingxamiseko.

get_help.heading: Apho omawuye khona
get_help.lede: Iingxamiseko zokukhulelwa zidinga isibhedlele, hayi ikliniki. Yiya kwisibhedlele sikarhulumente esineenkonzo zokubelekisa — Tygerberg, Charlotte Maxeke, Steve Biko, King Edward, nezinye kwilizwe lonke.

helplines.name: Uncedo olungxamisekileyo (iselula)
helplines.description: Ifikelela kuyo nayiphi na inkonzo yongxamiseko xa utsalela umnxeba ngeselula
